title: Data Analyst (BI & Quantitative Analytics)
description: Seeking an analytical Data Analyst to transform complex relational databases into strategic business intelligence, automated KPI dashboards, and statistical cohort models.
responsibilities: Write optimized SQL queries across Snowflake and PostgreSQL data warehouses.
Build and maintain automated executive dashboards using Tableau and Power BI.
Perform exploratory data analysis and hypothesis testing with Python and Pandas.
Collaborate with marketing, sales, and product leaders to measure business performance.
requirements: 2+ years experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role.
Expertise in SQL, relational databases, and data modeling.
Strong dashboard development experience with Tableau or Power BI.
Proficiency with Python, Pandas, and basic statistical techniques.
